The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring successful execution and performance of customer contracts. This role is the primary operational interface for our satellite communication customers, responsible for monitoring and reporting service performance, managing incidents, and facilitating contract renewals. Strong analytical abilities; able to interpret technical data. Self-driven with the ability to work independently. Effective team collaborator. Contract Execution Oversee contract fulfilment and adherence to service commitments throughout the lifecycle. Provide input for customer invoicing and oversee accuracy of billable service components. Cross-Functional Mastery: Work side-by-side with Electrical, Aerodynamics, Gimbal, and Production teams with complete visibility over how hardware moves from CAD to active flight.
